text:
Marta: Quick follow-up from today's roadmap sync. We still have open decisions on the public envelope shape vs enterprise needs. Need to finalize before spec freeze next Tue.
Sam: High level: keep GA payload compact for PLG users; expose richer telemetry only behind a compatibility flag or enterprise tier.
Alexa: Drafted a candidate envelope in the PR branch. Minimal GA idea: `payload` (string or structured), `meta:{model, model_ver, trace_id}`, and an optional `features` bitmask. No token counters by default.
PJ: Naming bikeshed: prefer snake_case across JSON (`model_ver`, `trace_id`, `token_counts`) — aligns with our logs. Avoid camelCase for new fields.
Dong: Operational constraint: Dedicated & Private must always return token counters for billing reconciliation. For hosted, make it opt-in via `features.token_counts=enabled`.
Sam: Can we define two levels: "compact" (GA default) and "full_telemetry" (enterprise opt-in)? Document migration path in SDKs.
Linford_CSM: Customer ask: large clients require a 30-day notice before toggling telemetry on for their org. Also need a toggle that returns historical telemetry only if retention consent given.
Alexa: For tool/function calls, customers want strict argument schemas and a stable invocation trace. Proposed tool-call response: `tool_response`: `{"tool_id":"org/tool","status":"success|failed","args_schema_version":"v1","result":...,"invocation_id":"rd-xxxx-uuid"}`.
PJ: Add `invocation_id` to map to traces. Use `rd-invocation-id` header for requests. Keep header names lowercase with hyphens.
Dong: We should also standardize trace header semantics: `rd-trace-id` is authoritative; `x-rd-trace-id` backwards compatible. Trace is a 36-char UUID; span ids optional.
Sam: Rerank API shape suggestion: list of items `{id, content, score, debug_provenance}` where `score` is a float and `debug_provenance` is an optional array of short tags. Keep field names short to save token bytes.
Marta: Launch checklist (working): 1) Spec PR merged, 2) SDKs add feature-detect for `features` bits, 3) compat tests for old clients, 4) canary rollout + telemetry validation, 5) customer comms + 30d opt-in lead time, 6) legal data retention signoff.
Alexa: I'll push the PR with examples for chat, tool-call, and rerank payloads. It includes a migration matrix and a small snippet showing how SDKs toggle `features.token_counts`.
PJ: I'll review naming and add a lint rule so future schema changes fail CI unless fields are snake_case.
Linford_CSM: Please add a migration note that enterprise orgs may require a toggle in account settings; include contact for support.
Dong: For Private installs, expose a config param `return_token_counts: true|false` with default true. Add a note about PII concerns for hosted mode.
Sam: Scope cut proposal: drop `attachments` and `rich_blocks` from GA. We can reintroduce in Phase 2 with a stable serialization format.
Alexa: Also including `meta.flags` map in the envelope: example "meta": {"flags": ["token_counts","verbose_provenance"]} so SDKs can signal expectations.
Marta: Ops note: infra will land a feature-flag gate on 2026-04-12 (ops-bot scheduled earlier). Coordinate deploy windows with customers.
ops-bot: Reminder: schema-gate feature flag deploy 2026-04-12 17:00 UTC.
Sam: Timeline: PR Thu morning, reviews Thu afternoon, docs + SDK examples up by Fri, doc-driven comms next week.
Marta: If nobody objects, we'll accept Alexa's PR and start canary. Flag any blocking concerns here.
Linford_CSM: NIT: make sure CSMs get a copy of the comms and a recommended FAQ for customers about token telemetry and retention.
Marta: Will do, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
